cases.data_state: One assistant message streams text and reaches a terminal text_end event.
cases.interaction_state: The conversation is open while WebSocket events arrive in order.
cases.expected_observable_result: Web and Desktop expose one stable assistant row keyed by message_id with the same final text and completed state.

cases.data_state: Durable sessions_history contains the completed assistant message.
cases.interaction_state: The user switches away from the conversation and reopens it.
cases.expected_observable_result: History replay produces the same stable assistant row as the live stream without duplicating message_id.

cases.data_state: The structured local capability snapshot marks Search and Workspace Collaboration unavailable until their local authority routes exist.
cases.interaction_state: The user opens a feature entry before any feature request is sent.
cases.expected_observable_result: Both clients derive availability only from the structured snapshot; Search and Workspace Collaboration fail closed with stable reason codes, while isolated sandbox remains not applicable in local mode.
cases.native_deviation: Local workspace and terminal are native equivalents; isolated cloud sandbox is intentionally unavailable.

cases.data_state: A decision request has already been answered by another client at authority revision 8.
cases.interaction_state: The losing client refetches pending HITL after receiving already-answered authority.
cases.expected_observable_result: Both clients render the canonical answered state read-only and preserve the authority revision without replaying secret response values.

cases.data_state: Discussion has revision 12 and a cursor gap marks the surface stale.
cases.interaction_state: A WebSocket reconnect invalidates the optimistic projection before canonical refetch.
cases.expected_observable_result: Both clients keep the same authority, revision, cursor and item count, and require canonical refetch for stale state.

cases.data_state: An editable Markdown artifact is loaded at revision 3 with a verified SHA-256 content hash.
cases.interaction_state: The user saves with expected revision 3 and a stable idempotency key.
cases.expected_observable_result: Both clients expose the same revision and content hash and treat the save as conflict-safe without exposing the idempotency key.
cases.native_deviation: Local content uses atomic rename while cloud content uses conditional object metadata updates.

cases.data_state: The service advertises KasmVNC while terminal resume and Rust file authority remain structurally unavailable.
cases.interaction_state: The client gates each runtime entry before opening a connection.
cases.expected_observable_result: Both clients enable KasmVNC, keep degraded terminal interaction visible, and fail closed for resume and files with stable reason codes.
cases.native_deviation: Local mode maps files and terminal to the native workspace and does not claim an isolated cloud sandbox.

cases.data_state: Run Now replays an existing V2 receipt for the same job, revision and idempotency key.
cases.interaction_state: The client retries after losing the first HTTP response.
cases.expected_observable_result: Both clients retain the stable receipt and run IDs, report duplicate true, and classify the result as replay-safe.
cases.native_deviation: Local execution is dispatched by the durable sidecar worker; cloud execution remains gated by server capability.
